beat: Childcare arranged; evening painting, cropped old T-shirt, paint spill and Chotu removes vest

lines.original: Chotu: didi... where is Pappu.
lines.local: Chotu: Didi, Pappu kahan hai?

lines.original: Dhika: uh dear, I left him with aunty. With us painting, I will not be able to keep on eye on him.... also, I am pretty sure later we would be scrapping paint off Pappu.... hehe
lines.local: Dhika: Dear, use Aunty ke paas chhod aayi. Painting karte waqt us par nazar nahi rakh paaungi. Waise bhi mujhe poora yakeen hai hum baad mein Pappu se hi paint khurach rahe hote! Hehe.

lines.original: Chotu; hehe..... yeah. Shall we paint didi.....
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, haan. Chalein didi, paint karein?

lines.original: Dhika: Giggling, oh yeah.... you change into the dress and start dear, I will join in a few minutes.
lines.local: Dhika hanste hue: Haan! Tum painting waale kapde badalkar start karo dear, main kuch minute mein aati hoon.

lines.original: Chotu changed into a new pair of vests and shorts today. The shorts which he wore today was very baggy and he liked it.
lines.local: Aaj Chotu ne doosra naya vest aur shorts pehna. Shorts kaafi baggy the aur use pasand aaye.

lines.original: Without waiting for Dhika, he moved into Pappu's room and sitting down, he started painting the bottom portion of the wall. The short felt so baggy that there was a free flow of air into it, which Chotu was enjoying.
lines.local: Dhika ka wait kiye bina Pappu ke room mein gaya aur baithkar deewar ka neeche wala hissa paint karne laga. Shorts itne loose the ki hawa aaraam se andar aa rahi thi, jo use achha lag raha tha.

lines.original: A few mins later, Dhika came back into the room...... Hearing her foot steps, Chotu turned to see her coming in, wearing the same skirt, but she changed into a loose piece of different T shirt, which ran only till her chest.... her entire stomach was bare and she was looking cute as hell...
lines.local: Kuch minute baad Dhika room mein aayi. Kadmon ki awaaz sunkar Chotu muda: usne wahi skirt pehni thi, lekin T-shirt badal kar ek doosri loose, chhoti T-shirt pehni thi jo sirf chest tak aati thi. Uska poora pet khula tha aur woh bahut cute lag rahi thi.

lines.original: Looking at him scanning her...
lines.local: Chotu ko use dekhte aur scan karte dekh...

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... I take it you like the dress...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, lagta hai tumhe yeh dress pasand hai.

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... yeah, but why you changed didi....
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe haan... par aapne change kyun kiya didi?

lines.original: Dhika: oh dear.... last time after I painted I saw so many drops of paint fallen on the T shirt. I don't want to spoil all my good looking shirts. Luckily I found this old one. she giggled.
lines.local: Dhika: Dear, pichhli baar painting ke baad meri T-shirt par kitne paint drops the! Apni achhi shirts kharab nahi karni. Achha hua yeh purani waali mil gayi, hehe.

lines.original: Chotu felt a stir in his baggy shorts looking at her cute stomach.
lines.local: Dhika ka khula pet dekhkar Chotu ko apne baggy shorts mein arousal mehsoos hua.

lines.original: Without any distraction(  not for Chotu) or talking, they both painted for another one hour and they covered a very good portion of the wall.
lines.local: Bina baat-cheet ya distraction ke—kam-se-kam Dhika ke liye—dono ne ek ghanta aur painting ki, aur deewar ka achha khaasa hissa cover kar diya.

lines.original: Dhika: ohhhhhh.... shit.
lines.local: Dhika: Ohhh... shit!

lines.original: Chotu wheeled around to see what happened.
lines.local: Chotu ne turant mudkar dekha kya hua.

lines.original: Chotu: hehehehe.... atleast you were prepared for it.
lines.local: Chotu: Hehehe, kam-se-kam aapne tayari toh ki thi!

lines.original: The brush from her hands fell on her elbow and smeared paint all over her elbow and drops of paint oh her left hand side.
lines.local: Dhika ke haath se brush uski elbow par gir gaya, elbow par paint phail gaya aur uski left side par bhi paint ke drops pade.

lines.original: Dhika: uhnnnnnnn... she cried... I don't care about the T shirt. Its all over my elbow and side of my stomach too.
lines.local: Dhika: Uhnnn! T-shirt ki parwah nahi, lekin elbow aur pet ke side par bhi poora paint lag gaya!

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... don't worry didi... I will help you clean it later.
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, tension mat lo didi. Baad mein saaf karne mein help kar dunga.

lines.original: Dhika: hmmm... she pouted her lips.... Chotu, you better remove your vest and paint.... I don't want you spoiling the new dress on day one itself..
lines.local: Dhika hont phulaakar: Hmmm... Chotu, tum apna vest utaarkar paint karo. Nayi dress pehle din hi kharab nahi karna chahti.

lines.original: Chotu: hehe you are right didi...
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, sahi keh rahi ho didi.

lines.original: This time without any hesitation, he removed the vest and started painting in just his baggy shorts.
lines.local: Is baar bina jhijhak Chotu ne vest utaara aur sirf baggy shorts mein painting karne laga.
